module_summary: Pieces split out of gui.cpp for the main menu ELF. guigameid.cpp draws the optional CosmicScale GameID barcode before a game launch. guimodal.cpp holds the blocking modal loop (ModalScreen) and its four users (message box, Reboot IOP prompt, remove-settings prompt, cheat selector) plus guiWarning, the wrapped-text helpers and the confirm/cancel key helpers. guinotify.cpp draws the top-right popups, toasts and RA notices; guioverlay.cpp draws the busy spinner, debug HUDs and auto-start countdown; guiqueue.cpp is the semaphore-guarded FIFO of GUI ops posted by the IO thread; guiscreens.cpp is the screen-handler table and fade transition. Most files keep thin C-style forwarders to the single global instance of each class.

reusable_helpers.name: guiDrawWrappedLines
reusable_helpers.what: draws '\n'-separated pre-wrapped text one centred line at a time, vertically centred; returns the last line's y

reusable_helpers.name: guiDrawMsgText
reusable_helpers.what: word-wraps a message to screen width minus 120 and draws it centred

reusable_helpers.name: guiConfirmKey / guiCancelKey / guiConfirmIcon / guiCancelIcon
reusable_helpers.what: pad key and icon id for confirm/cancel honouring the swap-select-button setting

reusable_helpers.name: guiMsgBox
reusable_helpers.what: blocking word-wrapped message box with Back and optional Accept, safe before GUI init

reusable_helpers.name: guiWarning
reusable_helpers.what: one opaque warning frame then delay(count), safe before GUI init

reusable_helpers.name: ModalScreen::run
reusable_helpers.what: generic start-frame / pad poll / keys / draw / end-frame loop for full-screen modals

reusable_helpers.name: Notifications::render
reusable_helpers.what: right-aligned notice box sized to the text, wrapping long text onto more lines

reusable_helpers.name: DeferredOpQueue
reusable_helpers.what: semaphore-guarded singly linked FIFO with enqueue/drain-and-free

findings.title: Modal screens render the whole menu (guiShow) and then paint an opaque black rect over it every frame
findings.problem: RebootIopPrompt::draw, guiWarning, RemoveSettingsPrompt::draw, CheatScreen::draw (and guiRenderTextScreen) call guiShow() and then cover the full screen with gColBlack (alpha 0x80, solid: renderman.cpp:122), so the menu render is invisible wasted frame time. guiConfirmVideoMode already dropped this exact call for that reason (guisettings.cpp:3457-3462), and the comments at guimodal.cpp:308 and 398 still cite guiConfirmVideoMode as having guiShow as backdrop, which is no longer true.
findings.fix: Delete the guiShow() call (and its stale 'same reason as guiConfirmVideoMode' comment) in the four guimodal.cpp draws and in guiRenderTextScreen.
findings.benefit: One full menu-screen render per frame saved on every opaque modal and status screen (INFERRED from the repo's own note at guisettings.cpp:3457-3461 that this render cost visible frame time); ~8 lines removed.
findings.evidence: Read guimodal.cpp:224-238,272-288,304-320,394-433 and guiwait.cpp:200-230: each calls guiShow() then rmDrawRect(0,0,W,H,gColBlack). gColBlack = RGBA(0,0,0,0x80) 'solid black' at renderman.cpp:122. guisettings.cpp:3457-3462 documents removing guiShow before the same opaque backdrop as 'pure frame time'. Only MessageBoxScreen (gColDarker when ui_ set) is translucent and it does not call guiShow.

findings.title: 35-line include block copy-pasted from gui.cpp into guigameid.cpp and guimodal.cpp, with comments naming symbols these files never use
findings.problem: Both files include ~35 headers (sound.h twice) annotated with gFAVStartMode, httpTestServer, bdmIsUDPBDLoaded, appGetObject, tarInvalidate, gLastDeferredTimedOut, sfxGetPlayDiag: none of these appear in either file. guigameid.cpp only uses opl.h (gApplyGameID), guiint.h (screen size, frame calls, guiDrawBusy), renderman.h and guigameid.h. guiwait.cpp carries the same block.
findings.fix: Delete the unused includes: guigameid.cpp keeps opl.h, guiint.h, renderman.h, guigameid.h; guimodal.cpp keeps cheatconfig.h, cheatman.h, opl.h, gui.h, guiint.h, renderman.h, fntsys.h, lang.h, themes.h, pad.h, sound.h, util.h, config.h, guigame.h, guimodal.h (confirm with one compile).
findings.benefit: ~55 lines removed in these two files (37-4 in guigameid, 38-15 in guimodal) plus ~25 in guiwait.cpp; faster compile, no ELF change (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Read all three blocks; they match the dupes-blocks lead (guigameid 22-58 == guimodal 10-46 == guiwait 9-45). Grep over include/ for the symbols each file uses: gApplyGameID opl.h:171, gGuiScreenWidth/guiStartFrame/guiEndFrame/guiDrawBusy/guiShow guiint.h:7-16, guiDrawIconAndText uidraw.h:8, cheatConfigIsMasterCode cheatconfig.h:14, gCheats cheatman.h:73, guiGameRemoveSettings guigame.h:45, delay util.h:67. The exact minimal set (transitive includes such as uidraw.h/dia.h) is INFERRED and needs a compile.

findings.title: GameIdBarcode class and private header for one call site; show() repeats its frame loop twice; serial length capped twice
findings.problem: GameIdBarcode (constructor, valid, draw, show, two statics) is used only by guiShowGameID and guigameid.h is included only by guigameid.cpp. show() has two loops that differ only by the draw() call. buildPacket re-caps the length at 11 that cleanSerial already capped (88-89), and cleanSerial's NULL check is unreachable because guiShowGameID returns on NULL/empty first (207).
findings.fix: Make cleanSerial/buildPacket/draw file-static functions working on a local u8[32], delete guigameid.h and the class, merge the two loops into one of GAMEID_HOLD_FRAMES + 2 frames that calls draw only while frame < GAMEID_HOLD_FRAMES, and drop the redundant cap and NULL check.
findings.benefit: ~35 lines removed (27-line header, class glue, one loop, two checks); output frames identical; negligible ELF change (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Grep guigameid.h over the repo: only guigameid.cpp:60. Grep GameIdBarcode: only guigameid.h and guigameid.cpp. guiShowGameID caller: menuitems.cpp:176 (prototype gui.h:210; host stub test_auto_vmc.py:244). Loops at 157-163 and 197-202 both do guiStartFrame, black rect, guiDrawBusy(0x80), guiEndFrame; only the first calls draw().

findings.title: RA notice timer uses an absolute clock() deadline, the wrap-unsafe form the class header warns against
findings.problem: renderRA arms raNoticeTimer_ = clock() + 8 s and expires on clock() >= raNoticeTimer_, while guinotify.h:33-35 (and guiwait.cpp:97-98) state that this form breaks across the 32-bit clock wrap; popup and toast in the same class use the elapsed (clock() - start) form. A notice armed within 8 s of the wrap gets a wrapped deadline and is dropped after one frame. renderRA's only caller is drawRA, always with y=10, yadd=35 (gui.cpp:360).
findings.fix: Store the start tick and expire on (clock() - start) >= 8 s like popupStart_/toastStart_ (a separate armed flag replaces the 0 sentinel), and fold renderRA into drawRA.
findings.benefit: Removes a rare dropped-notice bug in RETROACHIEVEMENTS builds and one wrapper function; ~5 lines removed.
findings.evidence: Read guinotify.cpp:84-94 (toast, uint32 elapsed), 148 (popup, elapsed), 178-190 (RA, absolute). Grep drawRA/renderRA: gui.cpp:360 calls drawRA; renderRA only called at guinotify.cpp:197. The clock() width and wrap period are taken from the repo's own comment at guinotify.h:33-35, not verified against ps2sdk (INFERRED).

findings.title: Dialog backdrop (full-screen rect + two white rules) copy-pasted at 7 sites
findings.problem: The same three calls (rmDrawRect full screen with gColBlack or gColDarker, rmDrawLine at y=75 and y=410) are repeated at five places in guimodal.cpp and two in guisettings.cpp.
findings.fix: Add one guiDrawDialogFrame(u64 backdrop) next to guiDrawMsgText in guimodal.cpp and call it from the seven sites.
findings.justification: Seven identical 3-line blocks become seven one-line calls plus a ~6-line helper: net ~8 lines fewer, and the dialog geometry lives in one place.
findings.benefit: ~8 net lines removed (7x3 - 7 - 6); no ELF change of note (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Grep 'rmDrawLine(50, 75' over the whole repo: 5 hits in guimodal.cpp, 2 in guisettings.cpp, nothing else; each is preceded by the full-screen rmDrawRect and followed by the y=410 line.

findings.title: Inline confirm/cancel ternaries re-implement guiConfirmKey/guiCancelKey/guiConfirmIcon/guiCancelIcon defined in the same file
findings.problem: guimodal.cpp:192-210 defines the confirm/cancel key and icon helpers (their comment says 'Everything asks here instead'), yet MessageBoxScreen, RemoveSettingsPrompt, CheatScreen and Overlays::drawSubMenuHints still spell out 'gSelectButton == KEY_CIRCLE ? ...' (about 30 such ternaries repo-wide, e.g. menusys.cpp, diaeditors.cpp, dia.cpp, themeelems.cpp).
findings.fix: Replace the ternaries with guiConfirmKey()/guiCancelKey()/guiConfirmIcon()/guiCancelIcon(); in drawSubMenuHints drop the icon array and pass the two helpers directly.
findings.benefit: Simpler, consistent button mapping; ~3 lines removed in guioverlay.cpp, otherwise line-neutral (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Grep 'gSelectButton == KEY_CIRCLE ?' over src/: 37 hits including guimodal.cpp 130,152,154,292,316,319,430 (plus the helper bodies 199,204,209), guioverlay.cpp 81,83, gui.cpp 399,418, guisettings.cpp 3448,3478,3479. Helpers already used by guisettings.cpp:3106 and RebootIopPrompt (guimodal.cpp:214-237).

findings.title: ModalScreen::begin is virtual but never overridden; MessageBoxScreen::wrapText only forwards to fntWrapText
findings.problem: No subclass overrides begin(); it only plays SFX_MESSAGE. wrapText is a private static whose body is a single fntWrapText call (and guiDrawMsgText at 115-120 calls fntWrapText directly with the same width).
findings.fix: Delete begin() and call sfxPlay(SFX_MESSAGE) at the top of run(); delete wrapText and call fntWrapText in the MessageBoxScreen constructor.
findings.benefit: ~12 lines removed and one vtable slot; negligible ELF change (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Grep 'begin()' over all .c/.cpp/.h: only guimodal.h:19, guimodal.cpp:52 and :70 (other hits are unrelated). Grep 'wrapText\b': only guimodal.h:39, guimodal.cpp:81 and :125. guimodal.h is included only by guimodal.cpp:48.

findings.title: Notifications::show repeats the snprintf / cut-after-colon / render block three times
findings.problem: The config, theme and language notices are the same six lines differing only in the format string id and argument.
findings.fix: Add a file-static helper taking (string id, argument, y) that formats, truncates after the first ':' and renders, and call it three times.
findings.justification: Three identical 6-line blocks become three calls plus one ~7-line helper: net ~8 lines fewer.
findings.evidence: Read guinotify.cpp:118-139: blocks at 118-124, 126-132, 134-140 are identical apart from _STR_CFG/_STR_THM/_STR_LNG_NOTIFICATION and the argument.

findings.title: guiCheckNotifications / guiResetNotifications forward to gNotifications, which gui.cpp already calls directly
findings.problem: The two forwarders have three callers in total (opl.cpp:359, opl.cpp:418, guisettings.cpp:2630), while gui.cpp:326-327 calls gNotifications.reset()/check() directly, so the same operation has two names.
findings.fix: Include guinotify.h in opl.cpp and guisettings.cpp, call gNotifications.check()/reset() there, and delete the two forwarders and their prototypes.
findings.evidence: Grep guiCheckNotifications|guiResetNotifications over the repo (C/C++/py): definitions guinotify.cpp:203,208; prototypes gui.h:173, guiint.h:13; callers opl.cpp:359,418 and guisettings.cpp:2630; no host-test stubs in .github/scripts. Direct use gui.cpp:326-327.

findings.title: DeferredOpQueue serial counter and enqueue return value are never read
findings.problem: enqueue returns scheduled_++ (or -1 on OOM), passed back through Gui::defer (gui.cpp:187) and guiDeferUpdate (gui.cpp:490), but all nine guiDeferUpdate call sites discard the result.
findings.fix: Delete scheduled_ and make enqueue/defer/guiDeferUpdate return void.
findings.benefit: ~3 lines and one int field removed (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Grep 'guiDeferUpdate(' over .c/.cpp/.h: callers opl.cpp:456,523,834,850,1759,1811 and guisettings.cpp:347, all as plain statements; prototype gui.h:110. Grep '.enqueue(': only gui.cpp:187. scheduled_ appears only in guiqueue.h:32 and guiqueue.cpp:13,55.

findings.title: Stale history and investigation comments in guigameid.cpp and drawArtHud
findings.problem: guigameid.cpp keeps fork-commit history and a NOTE(rebuild) about a helper that no longer exists and 'checklist item 48'. drawArtHud carries ~50 lines of debugging narrative, including 'THIS IS THE FIELD TO READ NOW' and 'an in-RAM index of the art folder becomes worth building', while the IX field documented a few lines later is that index, already built.
findings.fix: Delete the history paragraphs and the NOTE(rebuild) block; cut the drawArtHud comment to a short legend of the HUD fields.
findings.benefit: ~45 comment lines removed; no ELF change.
findings.evidence: Read guigameid.cpp:7-20,165-196 and guioverlay.cpp:134-218. Grep guiRenderBusyFrame over src/: no definition (the helper the NOTE says was removed). artIndexDebug is called at guioverlay.cpp:195 and fills the IX field, so the 'worth building' remark at 185-187 is stale.
